decision.ruvllm_small_qwen_screening: defer: no installed local runtime/model; inspected default Candle GGUF loader rejects Qwen2 architecture
decision.ruvector_failure_clustering: defer semantic clustering; use existing deterministic failure facets until diagnostic records and a verified native backend are available

actions: inspect workspace package resolution and model filenames
scope.cost_statement: No incremental model API request or GPU rental was initiated. This is not a claim that local CPU, energy, storage or existing hardware is free.

local_observations.inspection_bound: PATH, Node resolution from this checkout, and an rg --files --hidden --no-ignore scan of this workspace only; not a whole-computer inventory.

ruos.interpretation: Provisioning is not liveness. Missing heartbeat and unavailable peer telemetry do not prove enrolled machines are offline. No awake supported executor was established.

source_findings.retrieval: Public GitHub main commit API resolved once; raw source fetched at this exact commit. No source was executed or installed.

findings.finding: The npm engine explicitly warns that native query/generate has no language-model weights. Its JavaScript fallback embeddings use hashing. An import, native-loaded flag or nonempty response is not proof of GGUF model inference or semantic embedding quality.
Inspected CLI package is 2.4.0 and enables the Candle backend; Metal and CUDA are separate features. Installed binary version and compiled backend remain unverified.

The GGUF loader constructs quantized_llama weights and explicitly rejects Qwen2/Phi/Gemma GGUF layouts. Existing absolute GGUF paths follow a local loading branch; absent paths may enter a Hub branch when compiled in. Do not use aliases or missing paths for an offline check. A separately verified Qwen-compatible backend/build is required.

Model-load failure permits placeholder responses unless strict mode is enabled. Require health.mode=model and x-ruvllm-mode=model. Use non-stream requests and reject generation-error content; streaming can fall back to mock after a generation error. Non-stream usage is whitespace counts and finish_reason is always stop, so neither establishes tokenizer-accurate budgets or absence of truncation. The server constructs a generic role prompt rather than using the Qwen chat template.

The client requires explicit live opt-in and calls OpenAI-compatible chat completions. It does not verify model/mock mode; nonempty output without a judge scores neutral 0.5. It is not an Arena screening proof or a verified serving backend.

The adapter requires an explicit registry and configuration-verified flat, in-place cosine index with matching dimension and absolute storage identity. A generic npm dependency or an HNSW claim does not satisfy that contract. Numeric-vector search can avoid embedding downloads, but this workspace has no resolved native backend.

preconditions: Use the already authorized awake executor only; no wake, new host, rental, package installation or download.
Run inventory first. Stop if no installed ruvllm binary, no existing small Qwen model, or no verified compatible backend.
The inspected default Candle build fails the Qwen GGUF compatibility requirement. Do not treat its expected strict-load error as a model smoke success.
Record binary version/hash, upstream build commit/features, exact model and tokenizer/template hashes, model architecture, quantization and backend. Do not read provider credentials.
minimal_existing_executor_check_for_ruvu.conditional_strict_load: After a compatible build is independently verified, set RUVLLM_SMOKE_GGUF to an existing absolute GGUF file (not a Hub ID), confirm it is a readable file, then run: timeout 120s ruvllm serve "$RUVLLM_SMOKE_GGUF" --strict --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18080 --max-concurrent 1 --max-context 2048. Inspect installed --help first; stop if flags differ. Do not remove --strict to obtain an answer.

conditional_request.health: GET http://127.0.0.1:18080/health, timeout 5s, no redirects; require HTTP 200, healthy, mode=model and x-ruvllm-mode=model.
conditional_request.model_id: Use the actual identifier returned by that local server's health/models response.

messages.content: Return exactly the JSON object {"answer":42} and no other text.

conditional_request.limits: One completion request to the loopback server, 30s deadline, at most 64 KiB response; no retries.
conditional_request.acceptance: Require model mode header, nonempty non-placeholder content, no Generation error prefix, and exact JSON parse equal to {answer:42}. Preserve result as local model smoke only. Failure blocks screening; success does not establish Qwen3.8 fidelity or model quality.
conditional_request.budget_note: The inspected server's reported usage and finish_reason are unsuitable for Arena budget decisions; independent tokenizer accounting and correct chat templating are prerequisites for further screening.

minimal_existing_executor_check_for_ruvu.screening_scope_if_unblocked: Optional public-task format/action/observation diagnostics only, using frozen matched seeds and builds. Small-Qwen outcomes cannot select Arena difficulty, establish training improvement, or replace Qwen3.8-27B calibration or official private evaluation.

limits: Invalid assistant responses, detailed parser errors, finish reasons and reasoning content were not retained in v1. Eleven ValidationError records cannot distinguish truncation, empty content, malformed JSON or schema mismatch.
The three retained partial-credit cases permit local answer/rubric comparison but are too few to establish recurring semantic clusters.
The public capture is incomplete: 77 of 96 planned episodes, with 10 of 24 groups complete. Frequencies are descriptive, not population estimates.
V1 replay verified retained actions/observations/rewards; it did not attest the publisher's model execution. No private Arena traces or answers are available or needed.

minimum_useful_next_data.policy_status: Proposed operational threshold, not a statistical guarantee or RuVector requirement.
minimum_useful_next_data.diagnostic_threshold: Keep deterministic facets immediately. Consider exploratory grouping after at least 20 distinct complete failure records and at least five independent seeds per recurring proposed group; otherwise show individual cases. Include matched successes to identify features specific to failure.
required_fields: structured parser/validator error type and field path
separate prompt/completion/reasoning token counts and provenance
redacted normalized invalid response shape or local reference to retained response
minimum_useful_next_data.handling: Retain approved proxy traces locally. Index only allowlisted sanitized diagnostic features or redacted summaries. Do not embed raw private logs, credentials, official private tasks, held-out answers, or oracle expected answers. Publish aggregate categories and digest references only.
minimum_useful_next_data.native_backend_gate: Before indexing, resolve the exact installed RuVector version/native binary and execute a tiny numeric-vector insert/search smoke in disposable local storage. Reject mock/stub fallback. Use numerical diagnostic features initially; semantic embeddings require a separately verified already installed local embedding model.
minimum_useful_next_data.interpretation_gate: RuVector nearest-neighbor search is retrieval, not automatic proof of a causal cluster. Manually validate each proposed category against independently replayed examples; keep unknown cases unknown and separate cohorts by environment/model/template versions.
